mapper.select: SELECT L.LOAN_ID AS loanId, L.BOOK_ID AS bookId, L.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, L.LOAN_DATE AS loanDate, L.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, L.RETURN_DATE AS returnDate, L.LOAN_STATUS AS loanStatus, L.EXTEND_CNT AS extendCnt, B.TITLE AS bookTitle, M.MEMBER_NM AS memberNm FROM TB_LOAN L JOIN TB_BOOK B ON L.BOOK_ID = B.BOOK_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON L.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE L.LOAN_ID = #{loanId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOAN SET LOAN_STATUS = #{loanStatus} WHERE LOAN_ID = #{loanId}
